page: Amazon Web Services p3dn.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8175M processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base speed of 2.5 GHz and includes 33 MB of L3 cache, supporting instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES cryptography. System memory consists of 768.0 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3 GHz, translating to 8.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance is equipped with eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 256 GB of VRAM. For local storage, it includes 1800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, and the instance is optimized for both network and EBS performance.

Benchmark data indicates highly polarized performance characteristics. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression tests falling into the bottom 25%. However, multi-core capabilities are strong, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU tests ranking in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, reaching 4496.8 GB/sec for cached small-block reads. The instance excels in LLM inference, achieving top-tier status for prompt processing across small, medium, and large models, as well as text generation for medium and large models.

Given the high density of eight dedicated GPUs, massive memory capacity, and high-speed local NVMe storage, this instance represents a significant resource commitment. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for heavy parallel processing tasks where resource utilization can be maximized across all GPUs. The hardware profile is optimized for large-scale machine learning workloads, including deep learning training, LLM inference, high-performance computing, and data-intensive database operations.
description: Amazon Web Services p3dn.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for high-performance parallel computing. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8175M processor, it offers 96 vCPUs, 768.0 GB of DDR4 RAM, and eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs with 256 GB of total VRAM. Storage is supported by 1800 GB of local NVMe SSD, while networking delivers a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps. Benchmarks reveal weak single-core performance but exceptional multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities. Notably, the instance achieves top-tier results in LLM inference prompt processing and text generation for medium and large models. Given its massive GPU and memory density, it is highly suited for deep learning, large-scale LLM deployment, and high-throughput database operations.
